# Groot X Media

> Groot X Media is a premier full-suite digital marketing and growth partner helping enterprises scale revenue, build robust brand presence, and optimize digital acquisition funnels.

## Core Services
- Search Engine Optimization (SEO) & Technical Auditing
- Paid Advertising Campaigns (PPC, Meta, LinkedIn Ads)
- Social Media Marketing & Short-Form Video Strategy
- High-Performance Website Development & UX Optimization
- B2B Lead Generation & Automated Marketing Funnels
